name: Cleansing Hands, Lesser
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level adept 3, alchemist 3, cleric/oracle 3, druid 4, inquisitor 3, paladin 2, shaman 4, white necromancer 3, witch 4

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You touch the creature soothing their wounds and removing some debilitations. You heal the target creature 2d8 + your caster level (maximum +10) and remove the one of the following conditions: confused, dazzled, fatigued, sickened, and stunned. Instead of healing one of the listed conditions, you can reduce the exhausted condition to fatigued, the nauseated condition to sickened, or heal 1d4 temporary ability damage.
